notes.title: Tandem : A Tale of Shadows Developers Presentation
notes.content:
[b]
Tandem: A Tale of Shadows is now available on Steam ![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1436920/Tandem_a_tale_of_shadows/

Emma and Fenton are just waiting for you to discover the truth of Thomas Kane's disappearance !

 
Winner of Bit Summit’s Online Media Highlight Award and BIC Fest’s Excellence in Game Design Award, Tandem: A Tale of Shadows follows a headstrong girl named Emma and a mysterious teddy bear named Fenton as they attempt to solve the mystery surrounding Thomas Kane’s disappearance. 
Players have to carefully alternate between Emma’s top-down view and Fenton’s horizontal side-scroller view if they hope to escape these chiaroscuro dimensions alive, using the former’s lantern to cast shadows the teddy bear can cross while the latter activates switches that may be out of view.


Key Features
---------------

Stunning Art Direction
Discover playful and frightening worlds inspired by Jules Vernes, Conan Doyle, Tim Burton and Victorian era architecture.

Clever Puzzles
Solve over forty  puzzles and obstacles in order to unravel the mystery surrounding Thomas Kane’s disappearance.

Dual Gameplay
Swap perspectives between Emma and Fenton. Light up the scene and cast shadows as Emma from a top-down view. Walk on shadows projected by Emma’s lantern from Fenton’s side-scroller view.

Fight With Strategy
Players will face mechanical toy-like enemies and bosses throughout each dimension. Since Emma’s strategy is not to attack, players must rely on their wit to move forward.

Narrative-Driven Adventure
Players are invited to discover creative and elaborate cutscenes. Clever fans will find hidden rooms that reveal clues about the disappearance of Thomas Kane. 


The game is developed by Monochrome and published by Hatinh Interactive.

notes.title: Tandem: A Tale of Shadows hotfix patch
notes.content:
[h2]UI/UX[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adapted the main menu UI to correctly scale for 4:3 screens
[*] Added windowed mode in the settings
[*] Added VSYNC in the settings
[/list]

[h2]Localization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added correct polish font override
[*] Fixed the text for "Simplified Chinese" in language options
[/list]

[h2]Game[/h2]
[list]
[*] Redesigned the end level system to avoid Emma being stuck or killed during the animation
[*] Redesigned wall openings to be much more visible
[*] Minor visual fixes and improvements
[*] Level 1-8 : Increased the first spider’s speed to avoid getting soft blocked
[*] Level 1-9 : adjustments to puzzle 2 to make the passage more visible
[*] Rebalanced the difficulty in the last part of the Kitchen boss
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed minor key bindings issues for some menus
[*] Fixed a game map glitch when hitting "previous world", "next world", "down"
[*] Fixed a graphical glitch when going back and forth between the game menu and game map
[*] Fixed video cinematics skipping with only a short button press on gamepad
[*] Fixed Fenton being able to open red button doors
[*] Fixed minor collision issues
[*] Level 2-2 B, fixed a rare occurrence of Emma getting stuck on respawn
[*] Level 2-1 Fixed the collision near secret entrance
[/list]

notes.title: Tandem Fan Art Contest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972841/0f0c451fad7cabe8c8ee54464c41efa197a43f97.png[/img]

Pens up & Paintbrushes, Artists! 

Have you ever dreamed of winning a physical vinyl copy of the Tandem: A Tale of Shadows OST? How about a full game copy as well? If so, we invite you to come take part in our fan art contest!

We will pick 3 winners from all of the participants that submits fan art to our [url=https://discord.gg/v2Qgabc7Wp]#fan-art-submission[/url] channel on Discord.

[u][b]But first a few rules: [/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Anything goes! Your submission can be a drawing, painting, 3D printed, cosplay, or even a sculpture. If you can create it, you can submit it! However, please keep your submissions to an image format as videos will not be accepted.
[*] All submissions must be original and created by the individual submitting the work.
[*] Submissions will only be accepted on discord, in the #fan-art-submission channel. 
[*] Ableism, racism, sexism, homophobia, bigotry, or discrimination of any kind will NOT be tolerated nor accepted within this community and contest.
[*] All submissions must follow the server's rules, Steam User Agreement, and Discord Terms of Service. 
[*] One submission per user.
[*] No discussions in the event channel please, but feel free to react to the artist’s posts and show some love! Your reactions will help with the final judging.
[/list]
Works will be accepted until September 29th, 2021 (inclusive), and the event results will be announced shortly after. We cannot wait to see what you create! Come join us in the [url=https://discord.gg/Z4MYzCgWkk]Discord Server[/url] using this link:  https://discord.gg/Z4MYzCgWkk

[b][u]UPDATE:[/u][/b]
We completely understand that art can sometimes be stressful, and take a long time to make. With this in mind, we have decided to expand the duration of the contest until the 8th of October.

The rules remain unchanged, and all submissions will be examined on Hatinh Interactive discord. We are stoked to see what you’ll create!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972841/98dbaff0bccfae23c165639f84f7120bc68cf4a2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972841/3b4273de3a82bec135d4a5dd51fc99a04d36c787.jpg[/img]

notes.title: MGN Indie Game Carnival
notes.content:
Tandem: a Tale of Shadows joining the MGN online game exhibition!

MGN is an online conference focus on indie games, hosted by @Steamparty and collaborated between STEAM and ACFUN, we are aiming to bring more exiting games to Chinese players.
 
 
Event process:

May 31, 4.30AM PST / 12:30PM CEST / 7.30PM GMT +8 - Warm-up phase
 
May 31, 5:00AM PST / 1:00PM CEST / 8:00PM GMT +8 - Online conference
 
May 31. 7:00AM PST/ 3:00PM CEST / 10:00PM GMT +8 – Demo showcase
 
Despite being streamed, all videos will be pre-recorded and edited to ensure best performance.
 
Don’t worry if you missed the show! We will upload all content on ACFUN and Youtube Channel (nmb.ad/ytb) after event ends.


Join Emma and Fenton at the MGN Indie Game Carnival on May 31, 2021 (5:00AM PST/1:00PM CET/8:00PM GMT +8) !

notes.title: The MIX Game Dev Direct showcase
notes.content:
We’re excited to finally reveal Tandem: A Tale of Shadows will be featured in The MIX Game Dev Direct showcase on Saturday, March 13 between 9-11 am PT/ 6-8 pm CET!

The event, hosted by The Media Indie Exchange, is a two-day live stream focused on new announcements, game footage, special guests, and more, happening this weekend.

During the event, we’ll debut an exclusive video displaying an exclusive gameplay video of Tandem: A Tale of Shadows  for the first time ever!

We will guide you throughout different universes of the game and unveil a unique gameplay  

So stay tuned and save the date !
